extracted.intended_audience: general web users needing to convert lengths between centimeters and feet
extracted.subtask_description: Provide or use the formula and example table to convert a length given in centimeters to feet (and vice versa). Includes a conversion formula, conversion factor statement, and a table of example conversions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centimeters to feet conversion formula
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To convert centimeters (cm) to feet (ft), you can use the following conversion formula: Feet = Centimeters ÷ 30.48. In this formula, the number of centimeters is divided by the conversion factor divided to obtain the equivalent length in feet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion factor / definition (1 cm ↔ ft)
rubrics_metrics.description: There are 30.48 feet in a centimeter. In other words, 1 centimeter is equal to 30.48 feet (1 cm = 30.48 ft).

rubrics_metrics.name: Centimeters to feet conversion table (examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: A table of example conversions mapping specific centimeter values to feet (e.g., 0.5 cm = 0.016404 ft, 1 cm = 0.032808 ft, 10 cm = 0.328083 ft, 100 cm = 3.280839 ft, 1000 cm = 32.808398 ft, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides common/sample conversions for quick lookup and reference. Recent conversions list offers additional example values such as 79.52 cm to feet, 139.125 cm to feet, 178 cm to feet, etc.
